messages:
leo (eng-security): Heads up — customers reporting 403 at SSO callback after the RBAC rename. SCIM deprovisioning also appears to be stuck. Any ideas? :rotating_light:

maria (idp): seeing same. SAML assertion accepted by IdP but our session service returns 403. quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-22T10:12:45Z ERROR session: auth rejected uid=acct-123 reason=role_lookup_failed role_id=404
```

jon (eng-sre): did the kube rollout yesterday touch the idp-config? I did an env var reload for sso-connector around 09:50.

maria (idp): we ran a DB migration at 09:58 that renamed role keys. mapping in RBAC was updated, but I didn't add a legacy shim. could be mismatch.

sam (eng-security): also check KMS decrypt errors — we encrypt service tokens with tenant keys. if decrypt fails we return 403. worth checking.

maria (idp): grep shows KMS errors during the window:
```
2026-03-22T09:59:01Z WARN kms: decrypt failed Key=alias/tenant-root err=AccessDeniedException
2026-03-22T09:59:03Z WARN kms: rewrap queued alias/tenant-root job_id=rw-4421
```

leo (eng-security): that lines up with rotation. @oncall can you confirm KMS rotation window and whether rewrap finished before the RBAC migration?

oncall (ops-bot): KMS rotation scheduled 09:55-10:05 UTC for alias/tenant-root; rotation completed 10:00 UTC. rewrap job started 10:01 and was queued; processing backlog reported for ~10m.

jon (eng-sre): SCIM worker backlog shows retries then role-not-found after migration. example dump:
```
2026-03-22T10:08:12Z scim.worker: failed deprov acct-123 attempt=8 err=role-not-found
2026-03-22T10:09:20Z scim.worker: retrying deprov acct-124 err=role-not-found
```

maria (idp): repro steps we used: SAML login -> assertion contains role claim 'team:old-admin' but RBAC now expects 'team:admin_v2' after rename. no shim means role lookup fails.

sam (eng-security): hypothesis: ordering bug — KMS alias rotated and queued rewrap while DB migration completed and started returning new role names. some tokens encrypted under old keys couldn't be decrypted during rewrap backlog, causing session service to fallback to role lookup which then failed.

leo (eng-security): suggested mitigations? short-term and long-term.

maria (idp): short-term: add legacy->new role mapping in RBAC service (shim) so old assertions succeed. will canary to a few hosts.

jon (eng-sre): I'll expedite re-running rewrap for affected aliases and watch for AccessDenied spikes in audit. I can also replay queued rewrap jobs once shim is live.

sam (eng-security): long-term: add deployment gating so key rotations and rewraps complete before schema migrations that rename auth-critical identifiers. also add a pre-rotation check that fails if outstanding tokens/encryption operations are in-flight.

leo (eng-security): OK I'll open an incident and assign. notes:
- Incident: INC-20260322-001
- Mitigation: push shim + rewrap alias/tenant-root
- Postmortem owner: sam

maria (idp): I can push the shim patch. will do canary in staging then prod. ETA ~25m.

jon (eng-sre): rewrap job re-run started, watching logs. I will post progress.

sam (eng-security): I'll annotate audit logs for the rotation window and start the post-incident checklist (RBAC migration rollback plan, key rotation sequencing).

leo (eng-security): thanks all. follow-ups created and I'll update INC ticket with timelines. :thumbsup:
